description: The Public Service Commission - Amendment  to the Gazette. Ex. No. 2014/03 of 11.04.2017 that published the Delegation of powers by the Public  Service Commission,  w.e.f. 20.10.2017
reasoning: This gazette content involves the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding public service matters, specifically covering appointments, disciplinary control, transfers, promotions, and other administrative functions for teachers and public officers. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector administration, service conditions, and delegated authorities within the public service framework, without involving government structural changes or specific personnel appointments with detailed portfolios.
